Subject: DR validation artifacts + SIG/CAIQ RTO/RPO detail

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this. As part of OrbitData's SIG/CAIQ review and internal procurement, our audit team needs authoritative evidence for Redwood's Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery posture. Specifically we need:

- A current RTO and RPO matrix by logical service/component (indexing, streaming-index, embeddings, control-plane).
- The most recent DR runbook that would be used for a region-level failover.
- Results/logs from the most recent DR test (date, scope, pass/fail, issues).
- Backup retention policy and proof of last successful restore.
- Network failover / routing diagram for multi-region traffic cutover.

Can you provide these items or point us to a folder and a single contact who can walk us through? We are on a procurement cadence and would like to close open security items by the end of next week.

If helpful, we can set a quick 30-min call to review. Thanks —

Timothy Jones
Security Procurement, OrbitData

Appreciate the clear ask. We can provide all of the items you listed. Quick plan:

1) I'll upload the runbook, backup policy, and diagrams to a shared folder and grant access to your audit team by EOD today.
2) Priyom will attach the DR test log and the restore evidence.
3) Rishi will provide a service-level RTO/RPO matrix and a short note on what the numbers mean in day-to-day operations.
4) If you want a live walkthrough, suggest Wed 17 Feb 9:00–9:30 PT; otherwise we can do a recorded walk-through and Q&A thread.

We will include filenames and a short index in the shared folder so your auditors can find everything quickly.

Thanks —

Mina/Timothy —

Uploading attachments now. Included files: orbitdata_dr_runbook_v2.pdf (DR runbook, v2 — includes decision tree for traffic cutover), dr_test_log_20270212.csv (full test output from 2027-02-12 tabletop + live failover), backup_retention_policy.md (policy + retention table), and service_recovery_summary.docx (per-service recovery actions and owners).

Notes from the run: the 2027-02-12 test was a controlled regional failover from us-west-2 to us-east-1. Scope: control-plane + streaming-index. Failover was automated for the control-plane; streaming-index required manual zk leader promotion (documented in the test log). Total observed recovery time for streaming-index was 6m 20s (from detection to service healthy), which we map to an operational RTO of 7 minutes for that service (includes 40s margin for monitoring detection).

I'll share secure links to the folder: https://redwooddrive.company.com/drive/folders/DR_ORBITDATA_2027

- Priyom
From: Timothy Jones <timothy.jones@orbitdata.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Audit Team <audit@secureassure.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DR validation artifacts + SIG/CAIQ RTO/RPO detail

Thanks Priyom — quick clarifying question on the streaming-index number. Is the 6m20s measured from monitoring alert to full traffic acceptance, or from the execution of the failover command? Our procurement group prefers monitoring-to-healthy measurement. Also can you confirm the RPO for streaming-index and for embeddings (we have different replication windows documented).

Also we'd like to see the snapshot/restore proof for the last successful restore for the embeddings DB. Can that be included in the folder?

Appreciate you turning these around quickly.

—Tim
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Jones <timothy.jones@orbitdata.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_hadad@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DR validation artifacts + SIG/CAIQ RTO/RPO detail

Timothy —

Good questions. Short answers:

- The 6m20s in the test log is measured from the first monitoring alert (healthcheck failure) to the service reporting healthy and accepting traffic. We include monitoring detection in our operational RTOs. We add a small engineering buffer (rounded up) when we declare the formal RTO in SLAs or compliance matrices.

- RTO/RPO by service (summary):
  * control-plane: RTO = 60s, RPO = 0s (state is replicated across regions synchronously for control metadata)
  * streaming-index: RTO = 7m, RPO = 30s (near-continuous replication with short window)
  * embeddings DB: RTO = 20m, RPO = 5m (asynchronous replication, snapshot frequency captured in retention policy)
  * telemetry/metrics pipeline: RTO = 30m, RPO = 15m

- Snapshot/restore proof for embeddings: included in the folder as dr_test_log_20270212.csv with a restore verification row and a separate file rto_rpo_matrix.csv that lists the snapshot timestamps and restore verification hashes (for auditor verification). We have also placed the last successful restore manifest in the folder (object-level manifest referenced in the log).

If you need signed attestation language for SLAs we can provide a short attestation PDF from our Compliance team. Let us know if you'd like that included.

Regards,
Rishi
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

If you can drop the attestation and the one-pager into the same folder by end of day tomorrow we'll mark this item closed. Thanks for the fast turnaround.

—Timothy
